title: Story smoke: three Generation Build

story.sequenceContext: Alice keeps the same orange rain jacket while crossing the rainy station platform.

build.idea: At a rainy station platform, Alice notices a lost key, checks its tag, and returns it to the waiting owner in three feasible beats.

humanReview: Does the plan decompose the idea into three feasible beats?
Where dialogue is appropriate, does it use Alice rather than a technical identity label?
Are deliberately blank authoring fields usefully proposed without inventing identity facts?
